title: Sunday Daily Practice
subtitle: B5 · Home Sweet Home: rooms and furniture, /p/ and /b/
source: Foundation 11, B5 Home Sweet Home, Part 7D Homework (Sunday 1/11)
intro: Work through 5 steps. Deadline 23:00 the same day. Type your writing in step 4 directly into the box on the website. The final step is a recording: listen to 'My bedroom', then repeat after it; the teacher will listen and comment.

exit.label: Audio · Exit check: p or b?

steps.title: Step 1 · Flashcards: look, say, spell
steps.instructions: Look at the Vietnamese meaning, say the English word aloud, then type that word (spell it correctly). Do this 3 times, as in the homework exercise.

steps.title: Step 2 · Listen: p or b?
steps.instructions: Listen to 5 sentences and choose the word you hear in each pair.

steps.title: Step 3 · Grammar: there is / there are, in / on

items.label: There ___ two chairs in the kitchen.
There ___ a lamp on the desk.
Where’s the teddy bear? — It’s ___ the bed.

steps.title: Step 4 · Writing: my room
steps.instructions: Write 4 to 5 sentences about your room and type them directly into the box below. Use there is / there are and 2 location words (on, next to, behind...). Check: capital letter at the start and a full stop · there is / there are · 2 location words · 1 adjective · include a word with /p/ or /b/.

open.model: Mẫu khung: This is my bedroom. It is (small / big / nice). There is a ___ next to the ___. There are ___ on the ___. There isn’t a ___. I like my room.

ai.type: Viết đoạn ngắn mô tả phòng, bài luyện tập cho Foundation
ai.task: Viết 4 đến 5 câu về phòng của em. Dùng there is / there are và 2 địa điểm (on, next to, behind...).
criteria: chữ cái đầu câu viết hoa và có dấu chấm
dùng there is / there are đúng
có 2 địa điểm (on, next to, behind...)
có 1 tính từ mô tả phòng

steps.title: Step 5 · Sounds: read after the voice
steps.instructions: Listen to 'My bedroom' and repeat. Focus on the /p/ and /b/ sounds, and the final sounds of words like wardrobe, desk, lamp. Then record 1 voice note reading the whole passage.
lines: Hello! My name is Linh. This is my bedroom. It is small, but it is very nice. There is a big bed next to the window. There is a desk and a chair behind the door. There are three books and a lamp on the desk. There are two pictures on the wall. There is a wardrobe next to the desk. I like my bedroom.
steps.note: Thầy sẽ nghe và nhận xét phát âm của em.

send_today: Hoàn thành 5 bước trên web. Voice note ở Step 5 sẽ được gửi tự động cho thầy khi bấm Nộp bài.
